status: pre-registered after train-only gate pass and before observing confirmation results
purpose: one-time confirmation that the frozen multi-scale mechanism direction transfers from the train-only 64/16 split to official MISATO-100 validation

training.data: same frozen 64-complex development split; do not add the 16 holdout or official validation
training.determinism: retrain exact frozen configuration and save final state for audit

evaluation.access_count: one frozen evaluation after all three final checkpoints exist
evaluation.metrics: T1/T2/T3 standardized RMSE and equal macro; not official scores

confirmation_rule.primary: mean equal-macro RMSE below the already recorded paired one-step reference
confirmation_rule.seed_consistency: at least 2 of 3 paired seed wins
confirmation_rule.T1_guard: mean T1 does not worsen by more than 2 percent
confirmation_rule.T3_direction: mean T3 improves; the 5 percent threshold remains a stronger success marker but is not required to preserve a research direction

no_adaptation: do not tune horizons, loss weight, epoch, architecture or normalization using this confirmation result
